title: [2D Tool] Free Sewing
content: ### **Objective** Freely establish Sewing Lines on Pattern outlines and Internal Shapes/Lines. **Location** Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶**Free Sewing ** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001254128/_______.png) **Free Sewing** ** Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ **Free Sewing ** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001254128/_______.png) **Free Sewing** 2. Click, drag and click on Pattern outline or Internal Shape/Line to establish the start and end points of the first half of the seam. 3. Similarly, click again on another Pattern outline or Internal Shape/Line to establish the start point of the second half of the seam. → Drag the mouse cursor as a blue point appears guiding the length of the first half of the seam. 4. The mouse cursor snaps to the blue guide point. 5. Be mindful to make the Directional Notches parallel to each other and click to complete the second half of the seam. **※ Note:** * The face of the Directional Notch of a Sewing Line defers depending on the order of establishing the start and the end point of the Sewing Line. * Right click while establishing the Free Sewing Line to enter the desired length of the Sewing Line in the Create Sewing Line window. * Use the shortcut to establish M:N sewing lines. For more detail, please reference [M:N Free Sewing](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000497727).
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide for users to freely establish sewing lines on pattern outlines and internal shapes within the Clo3D design software.

title: 2D Snapshot
content: **List of Contents** 2D Snapshot Apply 2D Snapshot Save 2D Snapshot **2D Snapshot** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WxAcbVh0-tk \- Save Patterns in 1:1 ratio as images. \- Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Snapshot ▶ **2D Patterns(1:1).** **Apply 2D Snapshot** \- The 2D window expands and the 2D Snapshot window appears. * **Size**** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y-26CJkEgbA ** * Preset Select one among provided Presets. * Orientation Decide orientation of the image. * Width, Height Type in desired Width and Height for the image. * Resolution Assign Resolution for the image. * **Option**** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YOpEVFuKVk0 ** * Select which lines will be included in the exported image. * Select which images will be included in the exported image. * Select additional information included in the exported image. * Save the image with transparent background. **Save 2D Snapshot** * **Save as .****Png YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E-XzQW9s4zY ** * Configure all options, click Save, and select the Save as Type as .png. * **Save as .****Pdf YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pbdZO__htwA ** * Configure all options, click Save, and select the Save as Type as .pdf. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide for utilizing the 2D Snapshot feature, allowing users to apply and save customized 2D patterns as high-quality images or PDFs.

title: Physical Property Detail Setting
content: Adjust each item of the detailed settings to express Physical Properties not included in Presets. Each property mutually affects one another and a Garment's physical property is expressed by combination of all detailed property values. **※ Note:** * The property details are adjustable with the scroll bar or by entering in actual measurement values. ** ** * **Scroll Bar [0~99]** : This is better input method when the constant value is far too enormous. To reduce this inconvenience, the most commonly used Physical Property is split into 99 stages. * **Constant Value [0~1000000000]** This is better input method when setting far more accurate Physical Properties than the scroll bar method above.
content_description: "Customize and fine-tune the physical properties of your garments by adjusting detailed settings for a precise and unique expression of material characteristics."

title: Shirring (ver5.1.0)
content: ### **Objective** Express shirring realistically by reducing mesh size of the particular area of the Pattern. YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LdaeKbFWgZ8 **Location** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005494467/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png) **Edit Pattern ▶** Select a Line**▶** Property Editor**▶** Selected Line**▶ Shirring**** ** **Operation** 1. Click on a Pattern Outline using the ![____3.jpg](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360039919454/____3.jpg)**Transform Pattern** tool or ![____2.jpg](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360040742833/____2.jpg)**Edit Pattern** tool. 2. Follow the indicated path below: ** **Property Editor ▶ Selected Line ▶**Shirring **** ** 3. Click to toggle on the check box. → Shirring is applied to the selected line and the shirring symbol appears on the 2D Pattern. The result can be checked on the 3D Garment or on the 2D Pattern after switching the [2D Pattern Rendering Style](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360011148874-2D-Window-Display-Icons-ver5-0-0-and-Above-) to Mesh. 4. Adjust the **Interval** and **Height** of the Shirring. **Interval** | Adjust the distance between each mesh. ---|--- **Height** | Adjust the Height of the Shirring. ** ※Note:** Shirring is applied symmetrically when it is applied to Symmetric Patterns.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide on how to realistically apply shirring to patterns in CLO 3D by adjusting mesh size and using the Property Editor.

title: Reset 3D Arrangement (Selected)
content: **Reset 3D Arrangement (Selected)** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hxe0BwEXzQo When you place fabric using Arrangement Points, it wraps around the avatar in a draped form. If you want to undo that and return the fabric to its original, flat position, use the Reset 3D Arrangement function. \- Use **Reset 3D Arrangement (Selected)![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48000411030937)** when Garments are not properly draped after arranging them in the 3D window. \- Right-click on the Pattern to be re-arranged and select **Reset 3D Arrangement (Selected).** \- The selected Pattern will be re-arranged in the 3D window prior to the Simulation.
content_description: The "Reset 3D Arrangement" webpage provides a guide on how to revert fabric draping to its original flat position in a 3D environment, ensuring accurate garment simulation.

title: Delete All Pins on Selected Patterns
content: **Delete All Pins on Selected Patterns** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aeQR6lbGx14 \- Delete pins on each Pattern. \- Choose the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021552387/mceclip0.png) **Select/Move** tool from the 3D toolbar. Navigate to the 3D window and right click on the 3D Garment, and then select pin ▶ **Delete All Pins on Selected Patterns.** \- All pins created on the selected Pattern will be deleted.
content_description: This web page provides a concise guide on how to efficiently delete all pins from selected patterns in your 3D garment using the Select/Move tool.

title: Edit V-Ray Light Properties
content: Configure the light properties for the final render image. [![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45588624495001) Watch Tutorial Video](https://youtu.be/ume5lYEU9hc) 1. Click ![Light Properties On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45588624503961)**Light Properties** in thr Render toolbar. 2. Refer to the below table and edit the light properties in Property Editor as needed. It is recommended to use only necessary lights as the number of lights increase, the render speed may slow down. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Preset** | Set the Preset for the light. When hovering the mouse over each presets, you can check the result of applying light in advance. **Overall** | **Name** | ![Update.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45588523657753) Set custom names for render lights to easily identify them. **Intensity/Color** | Adjust the intensity and color of the light. **Activate** | Activate or deactivate the light. **Show** | Show or hide the light. Sphere, rectangle, and dome lights can be shown or hidden separately in the 3D/Render window. **Dome Light** | **Environment Map** | Load an Environment Map. Environment Map refers to light settings processed as an image (HDR). **Light Angle** | Adjust the angle of the light shines on Avatars. **Rectangle Light** **(Three-Point Light)** | **Width/ Height** | Adjust the width and height of the Rectangle Lights. * To create a three-dimensional render image, there must be a key light. Add key lights as needed to create more dynamic images. * When the Rectangle Lights are used along with the Dome Light, generally, a Rectangle Light is used as a key light. Thus, when using Rectangle Lights in combination with the Dome Light, use a HDRI image without a bright spot which acts as a key light. **Sphere Light** | **Radius** | Set the radius of the Sphere Light. **Spot Light** | **Cone Angle** | Adjust the angle of the Spot Light. The higher the value is, the wider the light area is. ![Cone_Angle.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360057379574) **Penumbra Angle** | Adjust the penumbra angle. The higher the value is, the more blended the light is. ![Penumbra_Angle.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360058215273) **Shadow Radius** | Adjust the sharpness of the shadow. The higher the value is, the more blended the shadow is. ![Shadow_Radius.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360057380494) **IES Light** | **IES File** | Load an IES light file. An IES file stores the data of the brightness and shape of the actual light in real-life. **Intensity (lm)** | Specified: The light intensity of the file is applied as-is. Custom: Adjust the light's intensity as needed. **Ground Shadow** | Show or hide shadows on the ground. **Open/Save** | Open or Save the setting as a file.
content_description: This webpage provides detailed instructions on configuring light properties to enhance the quality and speed of your final render images.

title: User Interface
content: You can customize the user interface settings. 1. Click the Main Menu ▶ Settings ▶ User Settings ▶ **User Interface.** **** 2. Set up the user interface as needed. **Setting** | **Description** ---|--- **Unit** | **Unit System** | Set the default units (Millimeter, Centimeter, Inch) to be used in the program. **Decimal Places** | ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48729358555289) Set decimal places per unit (from 1 to 5) to make pattern editing more accurate. **Use Ligne (L) for Button Width** | Use the button size in L. **Default Topstitch Thread Thickness Unit** | Set the default unit for topstitch thickness. **Currency Unit** | Set the currency unit for [the Bill of Material](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360045984074-Bill-of-Material). **Mode & Toolbar ** | **Default Mode** | Choose the default mode once you launch the application. **3D/2D/Render Toolbar** | Change the location of the 3D/2D/Render toolbar to the Top, Left, Right, or Bottom of the Render window. **Group Tools** | Group common tools to minimize the problem of some tools being hidden in the default layout. All manuals are written based on the tool grouping off state. **Show Manual and Video Links from Tooltips** | View or hide the manual and video links that appear in the tooltip. **Display** **(High-Resolution DPI Only)** | **Optimize for High Resolution** | By default, the interface magnification is optimized according to the display resolution. Change the resolution to QHD, FHD or 4K by turning off the option. When using multiple monitors, the high-resolution monitor must be set as the main monitor in the OS display settings. **Appearance** | **Line** | Customize the color of Pattern Outline, Internal line, Baseline, Selection, and Hover with thickness. Also, you can change the Line Length Size. **Highlight** | Change the color of the 3D Pattern Selection, Freeze/ Solidify/ Layer/ Bonding/ Solidify. **Font size** | Change the font size of 2D line lengths and angles.
content_description: Customize your user interface settings to enhance your experience and streamline your workflow with tailored options for units, display, and tool organization.

title: Edit Sewing
content: **List of Contents** **Move** **Properties** **** Select and move Sewing Lines or set properties. **** #### **Move** 1. Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001244507/________.png) **Edit Sewing (B)** tool in the 2D toolbar. 2. Click the point or segment of Sewing Line ▶Drag it. Or, right click to enter the Distance Moved while moving. **** #### **Properties** 1. Click the Sewing Line and set the properties. **Properties** | **Description** ---|--- **Sewing Line Type** | **Custom Angle** | Set the Angle and Strength of Sewing Line. **Fold Angle** | 180° represents a flat state. The internal line is folded towards the front of the pattern as the fold angle is closer to 0˚, and is folded into the back of the pattern as the angle is closer to 360˚. **Fold Strength** | The intensity of the fold is able to be set by adjusting the value of Fold Strength. The higher the value, the closer the fold is to the set angle. When a jacket and its lining are sewn together, the sewn area inflates due to the default sewing angle and intensity values. In this case, sets the Fold Strength to 0 to flatten the sewn boundaries. **Turned** | Sew two layers of pattern flatly. After selecting sewing lines, press the (**')** key on the keyboard to immediately switch the Sewing Line Type. If it is set to Turned, it is not able to adjust the Fold Angle/Strength. ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/13401097127321) **Tension** | When the 3D garment is expressed as being stretched more than the actual garment, adjust the Tension of Sewing Line. Same as actual concept, Tension is applied based on the short or long side with the Ease and Stretch options. **Strength** | Increase or decrease the strength of the sewing tension by entering the value. The result may vary depending on the Strength even with the same Ratio value. **Ratio** | Adjust the sewing tension's ratio to express varying drape effects by different sewing methods. **Set** **Sublayer** | Assign orders to the Sewing Lines on a Pattern which folds on itself such as seam allowances and pleats in order to increase simulation stability. **Reverse Direction** | Swap the fixed Sewing Line and the moving Sewing Line. **Sublayer** | Decide which side of the fabric is attached to the fixed Sewing Line. **Topstitch/ Puckering** [**![Youtube_Icon__1_.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/17203651731609)**](https://youtu.be/WRkb4MR0dP0?si=p0je5NkyY58c2i7w&t=2792)[**Watch Video**](https://youtu.be/WRkb4MR0dP0?si=p0je5NkyY58c2i7w&t=2792) | Applying the [Topstitch](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002752908-Edit-Topstitch) and [Puckering](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000617208--Property-Edit-Puckering-Properties) to the seam lines to create a variety of seam lines. You can save a sewing line with the properties applied and easily apply it to other sewing lines. **3D Seamline** | Set the direction of seam allowance on the selected seamline. **Normal Map** | Select an image to be used as the Normal Map. **Intensity/ Thickness** | Adjust the intensity and thickness of the Normal Map applied to the seamline. **Fur Trimmer** | ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55636284712089) Show the selected seamline clearly by triming the fur. 📝**Note:** The options are shown when using [Fur (Render)](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/search/click?%3D--d3e47a82d57d92fcfaa10db63e9249ce765c4e8e) and [Fur_Strand](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/search/click?%3D%3D--23de7be8c49f912b7f9f0d961a4e0d06a1ce05a8) materiels. **Thickness** | Set the range of Fur Trimmer. Example: Thickness = 10mm vs. 50mm ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55636287797017)![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55636287799193) **Gradation** | Set the Gradation starting position for natural gradient fur length effect within the range. Example: Gradation= 0 vs. 80 ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55636287800729)![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55636287799193)
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for selecting and manipulating sewing lines in pattern design, detailing their properties and how to adjust them for optimal garment simulation.

title: Apply Graphic Image
content: **** Place graphic images on Patterns. Use this function to express Garment details such as placed prints, embroideries, or logos. **** 1. Select the ![Graphic.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024687648) **Graphic (2D Pattern)** /**Graphic (3D Pattern)** tool in the 2D or 3D toolbar. **→** The file browser appears 2. Click a graphic image and a pattern where the graphic image should be placed. → The Add Graphic window appears. 3. Enter the desired values for the graphic dimensions and position and click OK **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Width** | Set the width of the graphic image. **Height** | Set the height of the graphic image. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005593967/img_ratio_1.png) | Link or unlink the aspect ratio of the graphic image. **Position** | **Outline** | Set the distance from the left, right, top, or bottom of the graphic outline to the pattern outline. This menu only appears when placing the graphic in the 2D window. **Center** | Set the distance from the center of the graphic to the left, right, top, or bottom of the pattern outline. This menu only appears when placing the graphic in the 2D window. → Graphic is applied to the pattern. → Graphic is applied to the seam across the pattern pieces as well. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55637475960729)** **📝****Note:** * Recommend you to apply and edit the graphic in the 3d window, when you apply the graphic over the seam. * **Add as Graphic** by right-clicking on the image file in the library. * If the AI/PDF file has more than one artboard and layer, select the desired artboard and layer in the preview window. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55637475960729)** ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55509962261529) * Use the![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55637475963801) **Show Graphics** toggle to hide or show applied graphics in the 3D window at any time. Graphics must be toggled ON to appear in 3D Snapshots or Renders.
content_description: This webpage serves as a comprehensive guide for placing and customizing graphic images on patterns to enhance garment details, including prints, embroideries, and logos.

title: Print Layout 2D Snapshot
content: ### **Objective** Save pattern layout as an image file in Print Layout mode. ### **Location** Main Menu **▶** Change the mode at the top-right corner**▶ PRINT LAYOUT** ### **Operation** 1. Select the tool/ menu indicated in Location. → Simulation mode is changed to Print Layout Mode. 2. Click on the **Snapshot** icon at the top-left of the 2D window. → The 2D Snapshot window appears. 3. Arrange patterns onto fabric in the 2D window. Be mindful of outline markers while arranging the patterns. 4. Set the file format, snapshot size, and other options. **📝****Note:** _When selecting the file format, the provided options will be different._ **Options** --- **File Format** | ![2025.2.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/56366200421273) Set the File Format for your Print Layout 2D snapshot. The following formats are supported: PDF / PNG / JPEG / DXF - Standard / DXF - AAMA / DXF - ASTM **Preset** | Select the snapshot image size. **Orientation** | Select the paper orientation. **Width** | Set the width of the image. **Height** | Set the height of the image. **Unit** | Set the unit of the print paper. **Resolution** | Set the resolution of the snapshot image. **Line Options** | Select the line and style that appear in the Print Layout 2D snapshot. **Add'l Information** | Select the information that appears in the Print Layout 2D snapshot. **Hollow Text** | ![2026.0.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/56366200424985) Set the text results as Hollow text or Solid Fill. **Show Images** | Select the image and colorwway that appear in the Print Layout 2D snapshot. **Colorway** | Select current, specific, or all colorways to export. **Fabric Texture Opacity** | Adjust the opacity of the fabric and texture. 5. Click **Save** , then enter a filename and select the desired save path. → Print Layout 2D Snapshot is saved. **📝****Note:** In 2025.2 or older versions, click **Save,** then set the file format (PNG / JPEG / PDF (ver 6.1)) for 2D Snapshot.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for saving pattern layouts as image files in Print Layout mode, ensuring users can efficiently customize and export their designs.

title: Unfold Symmetric Editing (with Sewing)
content: **List of Contents** **Unfold Symmetric Editing (with Sewing)** **Remove Linked Editing** Edit a single pattern symmetrically based on its center line.![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45585768975001)[ Watch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tj6VwcZyH0w) #### **Unfold Symmetric Editing (with Sewing)** 1. Click the **![Edit Pattern On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55524043014809)Edit Pattern** tool in the 2D toolbar. 2. Right click on the Pattern outline which the Pattern will unfold on the basis of, then select **Unfold Symmetric Editing** option. → The pattern unfolds as a symmetric pattern based on the selected line. #### **Remove Linked Editing** 1. Click the **![Transform Pattern On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55524043017625)Transform Pattern** tool in the 2D toolbar. 2. Right click on the Pattern, then select **Remove Linked Editing** option. → The linked editing is removed. 3. Or right-click on the unfolded pattern which is not symmetric and select **Half Symmetric Editing (with Sewing).** **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55508644256153)** ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55508599995417) **📝****Note:** Set a custom shortcut of **Unfold Symmetric Editing (with Sewing)** in Settings ▶ Users Settings ▶ Shortcuts ▶ Edit ▶ Context Menu ▶ 2D Pattern. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage provides step-by-step instructions for utilizing the Unfold Symmetric Editing and Remove Linked Editing features in Clo3D, enhancing your pattern editing workflow.

title: Steam
content: **Add** **Remove** **** Shrink or stretch Fabric partially like as using a steam iron. **** #### **Add** 1. Click ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005705067/__.PNG) **Steam** tool in the 2D toolbar. → All Patterns are now being displayed in mesh. → The Steam Brush appears at the top-left corner of the 2D window. 2. Set the value as desired. Mode | ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55473084672537) Sets the Steam Brush mode to Add or Remove. ---|--- **Shrinkage** | Sets the shrinkage level. **Size** | Sets the size of the brush. **Hardness** | Sets the hardness of the steam. 3. Click and drag on desired area to steam. → According to the shrinkage, the selected area is now being displayed in light-blue or orange. 4. Activate the ![Simulate_None.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024742287) **Simulate**. **** #### **Remove** Right-click on a pattern to remove steam, and select either **Remove Steam on Selected Pattern** or **Remove All Steam**. → The steam is now being deleted accordingly. **📝****Note:** It can also be removed from the same right-click pop-up menu with ![Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024742307) **Edit Pattern** or ![Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Transform.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024827728) **Transform Pattern** tools.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide on using the Steam tool in the 2D toolbar to add, remove, and adjust fabric dimensions in your design software.

title: Create Smooth Curve
content: **** Modify Pattern Outlines or Internal Lines into smooth curves. 1. Select ![____________.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115008231167) **Smooth Curve** tool in the 2D toolbar. 2. Click on a segment or point to establish the first point. → The point appears in grey. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55474976270489)** ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55473966000281) If you click where segments/lines overlap, a menu will pop up. Simply choose whether you want to start on the Pattern Outline or Internal Line. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55474976270489)** 3. Drag the mouse. → A grey arrow extending from the point follows the cursor. 4. Click on another segment or point to establish the endpoint. → A reference line is created between the two points. 5. With the reference line created, click on the side that will be converted into a smooth curve. → The entire side is highlighted in yellow. 6. Click & drag the reference line to create the desired smooth curve. → The entire outline of the selected side is replaced by the reference line. **📝 Note:** * **Cancel All Actions** While using the ![____________.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115008231167) **Smooth Curve** tool, press Esc or Ctrl+Z on the keyboard and all actions are undone. * **Cancel Last Action** While using the ![____________.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115008231167) **Smooth Curve** tool, press Delete or Backspace on the keyboard and the last action is undone.
content_description: Learn how to transform pattern outlines and internal lines into smooth curves using the Smooth Curve tool in your design software.

title: Avatar Properties
content: **Set the properties of the avatar.** ### 1. Click an avatar with Select/Move tool. 2. Click an avatar. →The properties appear in the Property Editor. 3. Adjust each properties below as needed. **Properties** | **Description** ---|--- **Information** | **Name /** **Item NO.** | Enter a name and an item number of the avatar. **Tech Pack** **(CLO-SET)** | Set whether to include avatar in the Tech Pack or not. **Body Styling** | **Style Configurator** | Set the appearance of the avatar. You can manually set the color of hair, skin, underwear, eyebrows, Eye and lips by clicking the Style Configurator button on the right. **Eye Control** ([![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/25701355515545)](https://youtu.be/CwB8_ad328M?si=Kw_eMEWqBpsPJlNX&t=1647) [Watch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CwB8_ad328M&t=1647s)) | Adjust the position of the avatar's eyes horizontally or vertically. **📝****Note:** This option is only supported for the new avatars available starting with version 7.2. **Surface** | **Skin Offset** | Adjust the distance between the avatar and the garment. Since the avatar and the garment consist of the meshes, a very high value of particle distance and low value of Skin Offset can cause the avatar to protrude out from under the garment. To prevent this, the default Skin Offset value is set to 3mm, which is the proper value for creating a garment. When you fit your garment accurately or create a fitted garment, lower the value of the Skin Offset. **📝****Note:** Leave the default value until you almost finish your garment, since the simulation is being slow when you lower the Skin Offset of the avatar and the Particle Distance of the garment. **Friction** | Increase the friction value to prevent a garment slipped away while draping or animating. **Static** | The friction when a garment is in stationary position. **Kinetic** | The friction when a garment is moving. **Soft Body Simulation** | Apply deformable body simulation to express skin elasticity. This option is available on CLO's default adult avatar, and can only be simulated with garments. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48890535328537)** Enables softbody simulation for custom avatars without skeletons. _* Soft Body Simulation cannot be executed on a Custom Avatar if the mesh contains**holes** or **self-intersections**._ **📝****Note:** Soft body simulation is reflected when recording animation to enable realistic expression, and soft body simulation can also be applied to 3D dummy or scan files converted to CLO avatars. ([![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/25701355515545)](https://youtu.be/WRkb4MR0dP0?si=gH3afGW0Szdn4nrZ&t=1881) [Watch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WRkb4MR0dP0&t=1881s)) **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48890535328537)** ![20252.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51882814533785) NVIDIA GPU is supported starting from version 2025.2. **Divide Mesh** | Adjust the number of the avatar's meshes to smooth the surface of the avatar. Be aware to use this feature when it is necessary. The higher you set the meshes, the bigger the size of the file can cause the slower speed of the program. E.g. This works best when you drape a fitted garment such as leggings since the meshes of the avatar appear. **Material** | Set the [Material](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047317454-Set-Fabric-Textures) of the avatar.
content_description: Customize your avatar's properties, including appearance, friction, and simulation settings, to enhance garment fitting and animation in your design project.

title: Press
content: ### **Objective** Use this function to create pressing effect especially for the edges of two layers sewn together. **Location** Main Menu ▶ 3D Garment ▶ **Press** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005491907/Toolbar_3D_Press.png) **Press** **Operation** 1. title: How to Use Pins
content: #### **List of Contents** Create Pin Select Pins Set Options Hide/Show Pin #### **Affix specific portions of the garment and utilize pins similarly to the**[**Freeze**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000376807)**function.** **It is also convenient when turning/flipping over collars, lapels, or cuffs.** **** #### #### **Create Pin** 1. Click while pressing W on the keyboard with ![Select On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/37876862445849)Select/Move tool on the 3D toolbar. 2. **Or** click and hold the ![Select Pin Lasso On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/37876895797401) **Select Mesh** tool for more than 2 seconds, then click the ![Select Pin Box On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/37876862414489)**Pin (Box)** or ![Select Mesh Brush On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/37876862418201)**Pin (Lasso)** tool. The mesh of all pattern pieces will be shown in red. 3. Follow the indicated guideline below: * **Vertex** Click on a vertex, which is any point in the mesh where edges meet. When hovering above, a blue dot will appear. * **Area** Click on the desired area on the garment ▶ click and drag to select the area. **** * **Segment** Double-click on a pattern outline in either the 3D or 2D window to create pins on a segment. When creating pins on the pattern in the 2D window, they are generated on adjacent segment vertices when the angle difference is less than 20˚. **** * **Pattern** Double-click on a pattern in either the 3D or 2D window to create pins all across its entire surface. * **Internal Line** Use the same procedure as above to create pins on specific internal lines and shapes. 4. Click and drag, or use the gizmo to move the pinned mesh as desired in the 3D window. **📝Note:** Click and drag on the 2D pattern while holding Shift+Ctrl (Windows) / Shift+Cmmd (Mac) on the keyboard to create additional pinned areas. Adversely, click and drag on the 2D pattern while holding Ctrl (Windows) / Cmmd (Mac) on the keyboard to remove pins from existing pinned areas. Holding Shift and then clicking and dragging will remove pins where there were some and add where there were none. #### **Select Pins** 1. Select the created pin in the 3D or 2D window using the **Pin** tool or ![Select On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/37876862445849) **Select/Move** tool. ![20252.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51883673085337) _**✨Tip:**_ You can double-click a created pin to select all pins placed on the same pattern at once. #### **Set Options** 1. Right-click on the created pin, and click the option as needed. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Duplicate to Symmetric Patterns** [![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51883353689241) Watch Video](https://youtu.be/GuIsZSACR84) | Duplicate pins and its position to the symmetric side/pattern in one click. Once duplicated, any position changes you make will not dynamically affect the symmetric sides/patterns. **Delete** | Delete the selected pin, pins on the selected pattern, or all pins. _**✨Tip:******_ While on the Select/Move tool, selecting a created pin while holding W key on keyboard also deletes the pin. **Attatch/ Detach** | Affix specific parts of the Garments to the Avatar. This function is commonly used for Simulation or recording animation for avoiding the Garment sliding off from the Avatar. #### **Hide/Show Pin** 1. Hover over the ![Garment Main Hover.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38100614520345) **Garment Display in** the 3D or 2D window for more than 2 seconds, then click the ![Garment Sub Pins Hover.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38100614524057)**Show Pins** icon. 2. You can also hide pins in [Print Layout mode](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000565568-Nest-Patterns) as needed.
content_description: Explore the comprehensive guide for creating, selecting, and managing pins in garment design, enhancing your workflow with intuitive tools and options for precise adjustments.

title: Ground Setting
content: **List of Contents** Ground Collision Setting Ground Height Setting **Objective** Set Ground Status and Height of the 3D window. ** Location** **Ground Collision Setting** Main Menu ▶ Preferences ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ Ground ▶**Collision On/Off** Right-click Pop-up Menu (3D window) ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ Ground ▶ **Collision On/Off** **Ground Height Setting** Main Menu ▶ Preferences ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ Ground ▶ **Height** Right-click Pop-up Menu (3D window) ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ Ground ▶ **Height** ** Operation** **Ground Collision Setting** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Preferences ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ Ground ▶ **Collision On/Off** Right-click Pop-up Menu (3D window) ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ Ground ▶ **Collision On/Off** → If Collision is Off, the ground vanishes and patterns endlessly fall during simulation. **Ground Height Setting** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Preferences ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ Ground ▶ **Height** Right-click Pop-up Menu (3D window) ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ Ground ▶ **Height** 2. Enter desired Ground Height. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides instructions for adjusting the ground collision status and height settings within a 3D simulation environment.

title: Register Pose/Motion
content: ## **New in 2024.2** #### **You can easily register the pose or motion from an FBX file as a file compatible with CLO avatars. ![Register Pose.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38075492713753) ** #### 1. Click the Main Menu » Avatar » **Register Pose/Motion** menu. 2. Select the type to register, either **Pose** or **Motion**. 3. Open the FBX file by clicking on the ![open.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38075383168153) **Open** button. 4. Select the Gender of the compatible CLO avatar and select the Shoe Type for female. **📝****Note:** If the FBX file's joint names do not match the CLO avatar's, it can only be saved and cannot be registered as the CLO-compatible file. 5. For motion, switch to Animation mode to play loaded motion as needed. 6. Click the **Save** button to save as the Pose(POS) or Motion(MTN) file.
content_description: Discover how to effortlessly register poses and motions from FBX files for CLO avatars with our step-by-step guide in the latest 2024.2 update.

title: Open/Save Fabric File (ZFAB)
content: Open Open (Select Material) Save Save a frequently used Fabric as a .zfab file or open a saved Fabric file to reuse. #### **Open** 1. Click the fabric item and the **Open** button in the Property Editor. → Load Fabric window appears. 2. Select a Zfab file and click the Open button. → The fabric is open with all fabric properties. #### **Open (Select Material)** 1. Right-click on the fabric item ▶ Click the Open (Select Material) menu → Load Fabric window appears. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55527387469209)** ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55333321245849) **📝****Note:**__ You can also open Select Material by clicking the fabric item and then clicking the Open button in the Property Editor. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55527387469209)** 3. Select a Zfab file. → Open Fabric window appears. 4. Select the items desired on Front/Back/Side and click the OK button. → The selected items are reflected in the fabric properties. **📝****Note:****** Press **Ctrl** on the keyboard while dragging and dropping the fabric file to the fabric item to open the 'Select Material window'. #### **Save** 1. Click the tool/menu indicated. 2. Click the fabric item and the **Save** button in the Property Editor. → The Save Fabric window will appear when saving. **Name** | **Description** ---|--- **Preview Image** | Texture Image is applied by default, It can be set to Custom Image. **Texture Image** | If the texture image has transparency, choose to include or remove the transparency. 3. After setting the save options, click the OK button to save. → The fabric will be saved as a ZFAB file with the selected options and properties.
content_description: This webpage provides step-by-step instructions for opening and saving fabric files in the .zfab format, enabling users to efficiently manage and reuse their fabric materials within the software.

title: POM Object Browser
content: ## **New in 2024.2** **List of Content** Folders Add Move Delete View Graded Sizes #### **Improving the POM object browser so users can organize and view they points of measure easily within CLO.** **** #### #### **Organize Folders** Using the folders within POM will allow you to organize all your POM however you like, for example you could organize them by pattern piece, or by measurement type, any way that works for you. ![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55674683001881) [Watch Video](https://youtu.be/v5VF7j7rrBc) ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/37883938236185) #### **Add** 1. Click on the ![add folder.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/37543357829657) **Add Folder** button at the top in POM tab in Object Browser. 2. Edit the folder name and then click away or hit Enter key to apply the changes. * Afterwards, double-click on the folder name to rename it. 3. Click on the ![add.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/37543357840665) **Add** button within folder to add new POM within a folder. 4. Click on the ![arrow.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/37543329543321)**Arrow** within the Folder to collapse all the POM in the folder. ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/37883938236185) #### **Move** 1. Drag and drop the POMs between the different folders to move them to another folder. * Hold down the Shift key to select multiple POMs at once and move them all. ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/37883938236185) #### **Delete** 1. Click on the ![delete.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/37543357842329) **Delete** button to delete an entire folder or POMs within a folder. **📝****Note:** If there are active POMs within the folder a pop up will come up asking you; _If you would like to delete the POMs or move them to the default folder._ #### #### **View Graded Sizes** When Grading is applied to pattern, you will be able to view or hide different graded sizes within the Object Browser POM to improve visibility. When a pattern has grading applied the Graded sizes will automatically appear within the POM Object browser. ![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55674683001881) [Watch Video](https://youtu.be/B3UdATm9Ylc) 1. Click on the size to hide it easily. 2. Click on the size again to quickly reactivate it.
content_description: Discover the enhanced POM object browser in CLO 2024.2, designed to help users effortlessly organize, view, and manage their points of measure with customizable folder options and improved grading visibility.

title: AI Graphic Generator
content: **List of Contents** **Open** **Generate** **Apply** #### **** Easily type in keywords to generate different graphic images to choose from to create new graphics. _* AI Graphic Generator is being piloted as a Beta service, and may be suspended to provide better service._ ### #### **Open** 1. Click ![AI Studio.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49960260626713) **AI Graphic Generator** button at the top of the Graphic tab. or Graphic Properties ▶ Materials ▶ on the right side of Basic Parameters → AI Graphic Generator window appears #### **Generate** 1. Set options, enter prompts, and click the Generate button. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Content Type** | Select the type of content. ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49960237570841) Generate embroidery graphics from simple keyword prompts, or instantly transform uploaded images into embroidery-style visuals. **Transparent Background** | Apply a transparent background to the image. This option is not available for the Pop Art type. **Text Prompt** | Enter the prompts. **✨ Writing Tips:** * **List the words.** Listing the desired words rather than long descriptive sentences can generate more effective results. * **Emphasize certain words more.** If parentheses are used in the word you want to emphasize, it takes up more weight.Parentheses on certain words take more weight. Weight increase rate : (word) 1.1 times, ((word)) 1.21 times. **![Frame 247.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/26624585871001)** ![icon_pin_off.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/26546607504409)**Maintain Prompt** | Even if the same prompts are used, the AI Graphic image is created newly each time. Thus, clicking the Maintain Prompt button may update the prompts while preserving the existing results as possible. It may differ from the existing results depending on the addition or change of the prompts. ![icon_random_dice.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/26546607511193) **Random** | The sample prompt is randomly applied. **History** | Previously generated images with prompts are recorded as history. History will remain until CLO software is closed. **📝****Note:****** It may take a while to create when there are many users at the same time. **** #### **Apply** 1. Click the Apply button below when the AI Texture is completely generated. → The result is applied to the 3D garment, and can be checked in advance. BUT, the graphic must be applied to it.
content_description: "Discover how to effortlessly generate and apply unique graphic images using our AI Graphic Generator for your creative projects."
